prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Miami for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively name one single “best” orthodontist for everyone — the right doctor depends on your location, your case (complexity), budget/insurance, and personal preferences. I can, however, help you find the best option for you. Two ways to proceed:

1) Quick guidance you can use now
- Search only for board‑trained orthodontists (not general dentists who offer Invisalign). Look for membership in the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO) and, if possible, American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) certification — ABO certification is a strong indicator of ongoing excellence.
- Use these tools: AAO “Find an Orthodontist,” the Invisalign provider locator, Google Maps + starred reviews, RealSelf (patient before/after and reviews), and your dental insurance provider directory.
- Compare providers on these criteria:
  - Experience treating cases like yours (children vs adult, bite issues, surgical cases).
  - Credentials: specialist (orthodontist), ABO certification if available.
  - Before/after photos and patient reviews.
  - Use of digital tech (iTero scanner, CBCT if needed) and clear treatment simulation.
  - Options offered (traditional braces, ceramic, lingual, Invisalign) and experience with Invisalign for complex cases.
  - Treatment length estimate, costs, financing, and retention plan.
  - Communication style, office accessibility, emergency care policy.

- Questions to ask at a consult:
  - Am I a good candidate for Invisalign or would braces be better? Why?
  - How many similar cases have you treated and can I see before/after photos?
  - What’s the estimated treatment time and total cost? What’s included?
  - Who will do the actual work — you or an associate?
  - What is your policy for refinements/relapses and retainer replacement?
  - Do you accept my insurance, or what financing do you offer?

- Red flags: no clear treatment plan, pressure to sign up immediately, very low price with vague inclusions, poor or no patient before/after photos, or a practice that is not a certified orthodontic specialty.

2) If you want, I can find top-rated orthodontists near you
Tell me:
- Your Miami neighborhood or ZIP code
- Whether the patient is an adult or child/teen
- Prefer braces or Invisalign (or open to either)
- Any insurance or budget limits

I’ll pull a short vetted list (3–5 options) with links, ratings, and what each is best known for so you can pick one or book consults. Which would you prefer?
